title: The new survival
description: Survival expansion for your new adventure
body: This modpack transforms the vanilla Minecraft survival experience through a collection of environmental and visual upgrades. Discover richer biomes, improved world generation, enhanced lighting, dynamic weather, and immersive ambient details that make the world feel more alive. While maintaining the familiar survival mechanics players know and love, the pack focuses on creating a more engaging and visually appealing adventure from your first day to your endgame journey.
